mandatoryAdditionalProofs.otherRequiredContractBoundaries: Each event has exact id, at, evidenceReference and evidencePin fields. Pin bytes and pointer resolve to at; evidenceReference equals path#pointer. Unknown remains blocking.
mandatoryAdditionalProofs.admissionHistory: Independently authenticated composition supplies exact asOf, validThrough and records. Each admission ID has state, evidenceHash, recordedAt; source request cannot supply trust. Unknown/stale histories block.
mandatoryAdditionalProofs.terminalStates: REVOKED and authenticated REJECTED cannot reopen under the same admission ID. A new reviewed evidence version and explicit authorization are required.
mandatoryAdditionalProofs.restrictedTransition: Prior RESTRICTED cannot become unrestricted with the same admission ID; an active history requires replay of its authenticated event.
mandatoryAdditionalProofs.eventChronology: Admission event must follow the history record as well as owner effectivity, acceptances and all knowledge events.
mandatoryAdditionalProofs.inventory: Unique admission ID must refer to the exact record being evaluated. Whole-report and component-statement overlaps cannot silently coexist.
mandatoryAdditionalProofs.jsonPointer: Strict RFC 6901 escaping and nonnegative canonical array indices.

schemaEvolution: Original sealed v1 artifacts and implementation stay intact. V2 is an explicitly selected stricter evaluator over the retained record shape; additional proof content changes evidence hashes and requires new approvals. No live schema or adapter is activated.
productionAuthorization: Always false; real trust remains empty. No database persistence or authenticated history provider is installed.
